title: Ask HN: How to deal with gen AI as an gen AI-resistant person
excerpt: Context: I don't like LLMs and code generators. I prefer doing things the old-fashioned way – code using my brain, write design docs while doing research. I became more flexible about vibe coding, but I still prefer to review Claude's PRs carefully. I'm a staff engineer with 10 years of experience in the industry but I caught myself not understanding a thing about agentic development, token usage, models, and I do have some FOMO but I also don't really care so much...
content_html:
Context: I don't like LLMs and code generators. I prefer doing things the old-fashioned way – code using my brain, write design docs while doing research. I became more flexible about vibe coding, but I still prefer to review Claude's PRs carefully. I'm a staff engineer with 10 years of experience in the industry but I caught myself not understanding a thing about agentic development, token usage, models, and I do have some FOMO but I also don't really care so much...

However, to survive, I need to be up to date with that trend, no matter if I believe that the AI bubble is a PsyOp.

Anyone in the same boat: people who are resistant to AI for many reasons but find themselves having to deal with it because the industry is leaning towards it? How did you deal with it? Did you have to let go of your principles, or do you just pretend that AI is awesome?

content_html_zh:
背景：我不喜欢法学硕士和代码生成器。 我更喜欢用老式的方式做事——用我的大脑编写代码，在做研究的同时编写设计文档。 我对氛围编码变得更加灵活，但我仍然更喜欢仔细审查 Claude 的 PR。 我是一名在该行业拥有 10 年经验的工程师，但我发现自己对代理开发、代币使用、模型一无所知，而且我确实有一些 FOMO，但我也不太在意......

然而，为了生存，我需要跟上这一趋势，无论我是否相信人工智能泡沫是心理战。

任何人都在同一条船上：那些因多种原因抵制人工智能但发现自己不得不应对它的人，因为该行业正在倾向于它？ 你是怎么处理的？ 你是否必须放弃你的原则，或者你只是假装人工智能很棒？
